result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: EmbedController#best enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) for every request without an existing embed, and embed/loading.html.erb reloads every 30s, so each popular page's viewers generate repeated enqueues. The only dedupe is inside TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? (a Redis setnx with 60s expiry), which prevents duplicate fetches but not duplicate job enqueues, so Sidekiq queue flooding is plausible. Minor caveat: retrieve_topic job class has retry semantics unseen, but the enqueue-side flooding is visible in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) is nil it unconditionally calls Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... , embed_url: embed_url) on every request, and the loading page reloads every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb) causing repeated requests. The only throttling/dedupe shown is inside TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? (Redis) which prevents repeated fetching but does not prevent enqueuing many Sidekiq jobs, so popular uncached embeds can flood the queue until the embed exists.
